```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}

```

```{r}
tb <- tapho_db %>%
  # keep metadata + the two list-cols we want; drop site_id & taphonomic_context,
  # and (by not selecting them) every other list-col and everything
  # after OverallProportionalRep_assemblage
  dplyr::select(site_name:sum_count, ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased,
                -site_id, -taphonomic_context) %>%
  # name each row's vector by that row's own element names
  dplyr::mutate(
    ReMNAU = lapply(seq_along(ReMNAU), function(i)
      setNames(ReMNAU[[i]], tapho_db$element[[i]])),
    ProportionalRep_MNIbased = lapply(seq_along(ProportionalRep_MNIbased), function(i)
      setNames(ProportionalRep_MNIbased[[i]], tapho_db$element[[i]]))
  ) %>%
  # spread both wide; names_sep prefixes so the shared element names don't clash
  tidyr::unnest_wider(c(ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased), names_sep = "_")

colnames(tb)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# the OTHER list-columns to remove (keep ReMNAU & ProportionalRep_MNIbased)
list_cols_drop <- c(
  "bone.level", "element", "One_Skeleton_count", "Skeleton_Section",
  "MNE", "MNAU", "MAU", "PercentMAU", "PercentMNAU", "AcReMNAU",
  "CumulativeReMNAU", "MNI_used_assemblage", "Mean_MNAU_assemblage",
  "Mean_part_abundance", "OverallProportionalRep_assemblage"
)

# name a row's value vector by its element labels,
# dropping slots whose label is missing/empty/purely numeric
name_by_element <- function(vec, elems) {
  v  <- setNames(vec, elems)
  nm <- names(v)
  v[!is.na(nm) & nm != "" & !grepl("^[0-9]+$", nm)]
}

tb <- tapho_db %>%
  mutate(
    ReMNAU = lapply(seq_along(ReMNAU),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ReMNAU[[i]], element[[i]])),
    ProportionalRep_MNIbased = lapply(seq_along(ProportionalRep_MNIbased),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ProportionalRep_MNIbased[[i]], element[[i]]))
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(list_cols_drop)) %>%       # drop other list-cols, keep engineered features
  unnest_wider(c(ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased), names_sep = "_")
tb
```

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(knitr)   # install.packages("knitr") if you don't have it

# ---- site lists ------------------------------------------------------
sites_up <- c("Abri Pataud","Předmostí","La Ferrassie","Xemxija tombs",
              "Regourdou","Kiik-Koba","El Espinoso Cave","Atxuri-I Cave",
              "Mladeč Caves")

sites_down <- c("Ojo Guareña","Kebara Cave","Abri de Raymonden (Chancelade)",
                "Vado all'Arancio","Abrigo do Lagar Velho","Roc de Marsal",
                "Roc-de-Cave (Saint-Cirq-Madelon, Lot)","Sima de las Palomas",
                "Le Moustier II")

sites_plot <- c("Sima de los Huesos 95","Sima de los Huesos 16",
                "San Juan ante Portam Latinam","Crow Creek","Mugharet es-Skhul",
                "Tepecik-Çiftlik","Mancos 5MT-10010 Feature 3",
                "Yellow Jacket 5MT-3","Grotte des Perrats")

# ---- column sets -----------------------------------------------------
meta_print <- c(
  "site_id","ind_name","individual_id","site_name","layer_name","count_type",
  "geological_period","cultural_period","culture_period_2",
  "start_date_cal_bp","end_date_cal_bp","mis_stage",
  "karstic_system","karstic_system_2","open_air_site","open_air_site_2",
  "region","country","mni","age_category",
  "n_infant","n_juvenil","n_subadult","n_adult","gender",
  "taphonomic_context","funerary_context","discovery_context",
  "degree_of_excavation","hominin_species"
)

feature_print <- c(
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_os_coxae","mnau_shoulder",
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_femur","mnau_arms",
  "density_adjusted_appendicular_axial_contrast","mnau_column_trunk_mean",
  "mne_vertebrae_to_thorax_ratio","ReMNAU_cervical",
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_metacarpal","mne_arms_to_legs_ratio",
  "mnau_legs","mnau_postcranial_total_mean","mnau_appendicular_mean",
  "mnau_upper_appendicular_mean","mnau_lower_appendicular_mean",
  "mnau_girdle_mean","mnau_distal_appendicular_mean",
  "mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean","all_sections_dominance",
  "low_density_survival_index"
)

# ---- helpers: build the two views for a given site list --------------
meta_tbl <- function(sites)
  tb %>% filter(site_name %in% sites) %>% select(any_of(meta_print))

feat_tbl <- function(sites)
  tb %>% filter(site_name %in% sites) %>%
         select(any_of(c("site_name", feature_print)))

site_groups <- list(sites_up   = sites_up,
                     sites_down = sites_down,
                     sites_plot = sites_plot)

# ---- print all 6 tibbles to the console ------------------------------
for (nm in names(site_groups)) {
  cat("\n================", nm, "- metadata ================\n")
  print(meta_tbl(site_groups[[nm]]), width = Inf)
  cat("\n================", nm, "- features ================\n")
  print(feat_tbl(site_groups[[nm]]), width = Inf)
}
```


```{r}
# ---- write all 6 tibbles into one .md file ---------------------------
out_file <- "site_tables.md"
con <- file(out_file, open = "wt", encoding = "UTF-8")
writeLines("# Site tables\n", con)
for (nm in names(site_groups)) {
  writeLines(sprintf("\n## %s (%d site_name matches)\n",
                     nm, sum(tb$site_name %in% site_groups[[nm]])), con)
  writeLines("### Metadata\n", con)
  writeLines(knitr::kable(meta_tbl(site_groups[[nm]]), format = "pipe"), con)
  writeLines("\n### site_name + 20 important features\n", con)
  writeLines(knitr::kable(feat_tbl(site_groups[[nm]]), format = "pipe"), con)
}
close(con)
message("wrote ", normalizePath(out_file))

```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

# ---- site groups -----------------------------------------------------
sites_up <- c("Abri Pataud","Předmostí","La Ferrassie","Xemxija tombs",
              "Regourdou","Kiik-Koba","El Espinoso Cave","Atxuri-I Cave",
              "Mladeč Caves")

sites_down <- c("Ojo Guareña","Kebara Cave","Abri de Raymonden (Chancelade)",
                "Vado all'Arancio","Abrigo do Lagar Velho","Roc de Marsal",
                "Roc-de-Cave (Saint-Cirq-Madelon, Lot)","Sima de las Palomas",
                "Le Moustier II")

sites_plot <- c("Sima de los Huesos 95","Sima de los Huesos 16",
                "San Juan ante Portam Latinam","Crow Creek","Mugharet es-Skhul",
                "Tepecik-Çiftlik","Mancos 5MT-10010 Feature 3",
                "Yellow Jacket 5MT-3","Grotte des Perrats")

all_sites <- c(sites_up, sites_down, sites_plot)

# ---- build plotting dataframe ---------------------------------------
plot_df <- tb %>%
  filter(site_name %in% all_sites) %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      site_name %in% sites_up   ~ "sites_up",
      site_name %in% sites_down ~ "sites_down",
      site_name %in% sites_plot ~ "sites_plot",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Composite axis for pelvic/femoral/proximal emphasis
    pelvic_femoral_proximal_emphasis = rowMeans(
      across(c(
        ProportionalRep_MNIbased_os_coxae,
        ProportionalRep_MNIbased_femur,
        mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean
      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Higher values = stronger reduction of distal/metacarpal/cervical elements
    distal_metacarpal_cervical_reduction = -rowMeans(
      across(c(
        #main
        #mnau_distal_appendicular_mean,
        #ProportionalRep_MNIbased_metacarpal,
        #ReMNAU_cervical
        #other
        mnau_distal_appendicular_mean,
        mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean

      )),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- PCA feature set -------------------------------------------------
pca_features <- c(
  "mnau_girdle_mean",
  "mnau_shoulder",
  "mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean",
  "mnau_postcranial_total_mean",
  "mnau_appendicular_mean",
  "mnau_column_trunk_mean",
  "mnau_arms",
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_os_coxae",
  "low_density_survival_index",
  "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_metacarpal",
  "density_adjusted_appendicular_axial_contrast"
)

pca_df <- plot_df %>%
  select(site_name, group, all_of(pca_features)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

pca_mat <- pca_df %>%
  select(all_of(pca_features)) %>%
  scale()

pca <- prcomp(pca_mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3]) %>%
  bind_cols(pca_df %>% select(site_name, group), .)

pca_var <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:3] * 100

plot_ly(
  data = pca_scores,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "sites_up" = "#D55E00",
    "sites_down" = "#0072B2",
    "sites_plot" = "#009E73"
  ),
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers+text",
  text = ~site_name,
  textposition = "top center",
  marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.85),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    "<b>", site_name, "</b>",
    "<br>Group: ", group,
    "<br>PC1: ", round(PC1, 3),
    "<br>PC2: ", round(PC2, 3),
    "<br>PC3: ", round(PC3, 3)
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "PCA of significant skeletal-representation features",
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_var[1], 1), "%)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_var[2], 1), "%)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(pca_var[3], 1), "%)"))
    )
  )
```
